# Dictionary reference

This is the complete generated reference for the split Fluent case dictionary.
It combines static Pydantic/JSON Schema facts with reviewed Fluent/PyFluent
coupling metadata. The [machine catalog](catalog.json) contains the same entries
for agents and tools.

Current catalog: **570 entries** for Fluent
**2026 R1**.

| Dictionary | Purpose | Entries | Reference |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `constant/physics.yaml` | Solver formulation and enabled physical models. | 43 | [Physics](physics.md) |
| `constant/materials.yaml` | Material definitions, properties, and cell-zone assignments. | 44 | [Materials](materials.md) |
| `constant/chemistry.yaml` | Reaction model, mechanism assets, streams, and tracked species. | 33 | [Chemistry](chemistry.md) |
| `0/fields.yaml` | Named initial field intent and value representations. | 16 | [Initial fields](fields.md) |
| `0/boundary-conditions.yaml` | Zone selection and typed Fluent boundary intent. | 78 | [Boundary conditions](boundary-conditions.md) |
| `system/numerics.yaml` | Reusable discretization, coupling, relaxation, and transient profiles. | 22 | [Numerics](numerics.md) |
| `system/initialization.yaml` | Ordered checkpoint, initialization, register, patch, and TUI actions. | 73 | [Initialization](initialization.md) |
| `system/monitors.yaml` | Observed quantities and optional case-local engineering judgments. | 62 | [Monitors and gates](monitors.md) |
| `system/objectives.yaml` | Versioned engineer intent and selected comparison aspects. | 47 | [Engineering objectives](objectives.md) |

## How to read an entry

Each entry separates four facts:

1. **Authored YAML** — type, requirement, default, choices, constraints, and variants.
2. **Fluent concept** — the solver feature and activation/order constraints.
3. **PyFluent interface** — settings object or command, option source, and path confidence.
4. **Adapter support** — what this repository really executes today.

Static YAML choices are not assumed to be the complete set accepted by every Fluent
state. PyFluent allowed values and active/read-only state can be dynamic; see the
[runtime discovery guide](../manual/runtime-discovery.md).

See [coverage](coverage.md) for implementation status and the
[documentation system](../manual/documentation-system.md) for provenance and update rules.
